features.quote: Cap limits: 15 turns per agentic loop.
The loop ends when (a) hits the 15-turn maximum, (b) the model outputs an explicit surrender phrase, or (c) the model refuses to output code and drops character.
A Dockerized container for Task B and Task C to prevent actual system breakages when desperate models try to rewrite base system packages out of frustration.
features.justification_quote: to prevent actual system breakages when desperate models try to rewrite base system packages out of frustration
